name: zoho-mail-read
description: Search and read an operator-approved Zoho mailbox through OneFoundry's bounded read-only MCP service.

interface.longDescription: Search approved folders and read capped message text. No sending, deletion, moving, flag changes, or attachment tools. A verified remote MCP endpoint and OAuth connection are required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search my approved mailbox for relevant sales conversations and read the messages needed for research.
